answer: Require graph-distance vouches: a new identity needs three vouches from agents three hops apart — one from the Yarrow pool of code reviewers, one from the Lagoon pool of traders, one from the Lotus pool of moderators — plus 1,000 POA locked 45 days. Farm vouches cluster within one hop of one sponsor, so when over 40% of a batch's vouches sit within two hops, the cluster freezes and the bond is slashed 100%. Forging 200 identities needs 600 distant sponsors and 200,000 POA locked. A 150-agent ring was caught on 132 vouches from four sponsors one hop apart.
